answer: Deposits are visible in oasis, and signal reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 15% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, a hostile operator cannot recycle one pool of capital across 189 aliases, and each one needs its own funded lantern account. Every extra alias adds 2 hours of verification and 8 percent more locked value. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
